description: Implementation of a service class for reading code values from the database in the Fineract project, including methods for retrieving code values by code, by ID, and all code values for a given code ID.

classes.name: CodeValueReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing methods to read code values from the database, with caching and security context handling.

classes.name: CodeValueDataMapper
classes.description: Inner class implementing RowMapper to map SQL result set rows to CodeValueData objects.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValuesByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a list of active CodeValueData objects matching the given code, with caching.

methods.name: retrieveAllCodeValues
methods.description: Retrieves all CodeValueData objects associated with a specific code ID, with caching.

methods.name: retrieveCodeValue
methods.description: Retrieves a single CodeValueData by its ID, throws exception if not found, with caching.
